text:
maya: Quick sync — packaging incentive models for private deploys. Need a decision by EOW on whether we subsidize customer-managed public IP reservations for early enterprise customers. This affects installer UX + SOWs + upgrade path planning.

samir: Can you bullet the options?

maya: Sure — two main options: 1) Offer a one-time credit to cover IP reservation + connector config for first 6 months. 2) Build an opt-in `preserve-egress-ip` installer mode and charge for it in Dedicated/Private pricing.

kevin: Option 1 is easiest to sell but costs shrink margins. Option 2 is engineering work — need install + upgrade tests and fallback to relay.

elaine: From sales: customers keep asking for IP preservation so they can keep firewall rules. If we can't promise it, they push back on pilot. Credits would unblock deals fast. :thinking:

aj: Tech tradeoffs: preserve-egress-ip requires per-tenant static NAT + operator docs and a failsafe that switches to relay when IP changes. Also need E2E tests for zero-downtime upgrades.

maya: Proposed middle path: small pilot credit + parallel sprint to build `preserve-egress-ip` in q2. Pilot customers get the credit and we validate installer UX.

kevin: Agree but we must define launch acceptance criteria before committing engineering cycles: 1) install flow with `preserve-egress_ip: true` works in airgapped and VPC; 2) upgrade path preserves IP 95% of the time in CI; 3) rollback plan documented; 4) sales SOW template with pricing.

samir: Add: automated smoke test that verifies outbound IP across upgrades. Put it in nightly.

maya: Good. I'll draft a one-pager for the pilot offer and SOW language. Quick thumb: are folks comfortable with pilot credit + follow-up engineering? @kevin @elaine @samir :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

kevin: :thumbsup: but we need an engineering estimate (T-shirt).

elaine: :thumbsup: sales will take pilot credits for early renewals but want clear upgrade SLA language.

samir: :thumbsup: I'll scope the test work and send estimate by Tue.

ops-bot: NOTE: Created task INF-5234: "pilot — customer IP reservation credit + preserve-egress-ip spike" assigned to samir. ETA 2026-04-08.

maya: Thanks — next steps: samir to post estimates, kevin to confirm capacity for q2 sprint, me to prep SOW and pilot comms. I'll follow up with a short retro after first 2 pilot customers.

kevin: One more ask — include a fallback policy in the product config like `egress: { mode: "prefer_static", fallback: "relay" }` so operators can choose.

maya: Noted — I'll include config example in spec. Example: ```yaml
installer:
  preserve_egress_ip: true
  egress:
    mode: "prefer_static" # options: prefer_static | prefer_relay
    fallback: "relay"
```

elaine: Great — this gives customer control and sales a clear messaging point.

maya: I'll run a quick decision sync on Friday 09:30 PT. If anyone has hard objections, flag here or DM.

samir: I'll post the test plan + rough estimate tomorrow.

kevin: Will check sprint capacity and reply by Thu.

maya: Thanks everyone.
